COM.note: Document is about tax system interfacing, not procurement.
Finance ministry notice; no central bank role stated.
No consumer protection rule or redress stated.
No survey share of adults stated.
Mobile banking platforms are mentioned only as the interface target; no service status stated.

facts.fact: The Comoros finance ministry, through the AFD-funded PAGF-SI project, called for consultants to study interfacing its tax system SIGIT with the mobile banking platforms of banks and mobile operators, expressions of interest due 28 October 2025.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, Budget and Banking Sector
